bullets: Architected a \textbf{claims processing MVP platform}, automating the end-to-end insurance lifecycle and reducing manual review overhead by \textbf{80\%} via \textbf{Straight-Through Processing (STP)}.
Integrated a secure ingestion pipeline using \textbf{Gmail Connectors} and \textbf{OAuth2}.

Developed an AI-driven medical coding system using \textbf{RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)} and \textbf{vector databases} to map complex clinical narratives to ICD-10 codes, achieving \textbf{over 95\% accuracy} in diagnosis extraction.
